title: Rav Ika son of Rav Chinena or Chananya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 39a and Eruvin 100b; in Pesachim 83b “bar Chinena”; and in Chullin 90b “bar Chanina,” from which Hyman infers that he preceded Rav Ashi. On chronological grounds Hyman considers him a grandson of Rav Ika, the father of Rav Acha.

notes.text: סדרי הדורות here is the chronological order of the generations, not an explicit citation of the book Seder HaDorot. The proposed grandfather relationship is Hyman’s chronological inference; the Chinena/Chanina forms remain distinct.

The consulted Eruvin 100b and Pesachim 83b read Chinena and Chullin 90b reads Chanina. The supplied Shabbat 39a locator is retained. The proposed chronology and grandfather relationship are Hyman’s judgments.
